# Configuration comparison samples

These tiny examples are synthetic test inputs. They contain no PeopleSoft identifiers, hostnames, credentials, server details, or production values.

Oracle's PeopleTools 8.62 System and Server Administration manual describes `PSAPPSRV.CFG` as similar to an INI file because parameters are grouped into sections: [Oracle manual, April 2025](https://docs.oracle.com/cd/G23955_01/psft/pdf/pt862tsvt-b042025.pdf). MPU implements a strict, deliberately limited INI-style text subset and ordinary JSON objects. It does not claim native `PSAPPSRV.CFG`, PSADMIN, export/import, continuation, override-list, template, script, or runtime-expansion compatibility.

The samples illustrate input syntax only. They do not establish runtime configuration or version compatibility.
